description: Search PixelVault for pre-cleared, commercially licensed AI-generated assets matched to a creative brief. Every asset is sourced from licensed AI platforms (Adobe Firefly, Moonvalley) and carries a compliance-cleared status. Returns a ranked shortlist of 5–10 assets with compliance status, format, platform, and rationale. Use this when an agent needs to source licensed visual assets for post production, editorial, or e-commerce.

brief.description: Natural language description of the visual asset needed. Include setting, tone, narrative function, distribution platform, and territory if known.

format.description: Asset format filter. Omit to return all formats.

license_type.description: License type required. Film & TV for broadcast/streaming, Editorial for news/publishing, Commercial for brand/ecommerce. Auto-detected from brief if omitted.

territory.description: Distribution territory (e.g., "Worldwide", "US Only"). Informational — included in usage agreement.

name: search_assets
